name: aeg-d-strong-lensing
title: Galaxy-scale strong lenses: projected mass inside the Einstein radius against projected stars and gas in the same cylinder
description: Atlas re-issue of aeg-d-strong-lensing/v1 under data standard 2.5.1 (D-083, D-084): the same 147 rows and values as v1 (one projected g_obs and g_bar per lens at the Einstein radius, D-064), with the uncertainty terms read at source in step A, confidence levels, and two corrections to how uncertainties are carried (known issue #139). (1) The Einstein-radius (θ_E) error moves from g_obs to g_bar (standard §2a rule 7; adjudication F1): where M_E is the mass inside the radius of mean convergence 1, g_obs = π G Σ_cr does not depend on θ_E, so a θ_E error moves g_bar and R_E, not g_obs; v1 carried it on g_obs "at fixed R_E". (2) Distance enters g_obs at first order (D-094, replacing D-064 item 4; F2): g_obs ∝ H0 at fixed Ω_m and ∝ 1/D_l for a lens-distance change, while the stellar g_bar is distance-free; the H0 pairs and peculiar-velocity sizes the sources state are uncertainty terms (D-104 rule 1). Where no single-component light profile is printed (the two MaNGA lenses, NGC 6505 and J0403−0239): θ_E error stated; effect on g_bar not computed (D-104 rule 3). The central black hole is not added to g_bar (D-104 rule 2): every size the sources quote comes from an M_BH–σ scaling of the lens's own velocity dispersion, an input from the system's own kinematics; R28 sizes it at "2 per cent of M_Ein" for SNL-0 (lensz_arXiv.tex l. 693), which is a larger share of M*(<R_E), and so of g_bar, because M* is only part of M_Ein. No value changes: the frozen second reading found no source-stated preferred value or exclusion that differs from v1 (D-096). See REPRODUCTION.md, REPRODUCTION_RESULT.md and SECOND_READING.md; v1's tests and checks stand for the unchanged values.
x_licence_status: Original papers and journal tables: values transcribed with citation, not redistributed (all rights reserved at the journal or arXiv non-exclusive licence, per the packaging inventory; R9 and R33 are CC BY on arXiv). VizieR and AAS machine-readable tables: linked and hash-verified, not redistributed. Atlas tables intended CC BY 4.0 under D-004, citing the sources.

x_baryon_inventory.component: central black hole (SNELLS, MaNGA and NGC 6505 sources)
x_baryon_inventory.citation: R25 (SNELLS): "Other possible non-stellar mass contributions within the Einstein radius, e.g. gas and central black holes, are neglected." (snellsI_arxiv.tex l. 769); R28 (SNL-0): "We neglected the extra mass that would be contributed by a central super-massive black hole." (lensz_arXiv.tex l. 691); R30 (NGC 6505): "Since this corresponds to only $(0.57^{+0.68}_{-0.31})\%$ of the mass within the Einstein radius, we do not include it in our analysis." (ms.tex l. 778); R32 (MaNGA): "(and in principle from a central black hole, gas, etc but these are expected to be negligible)" (main.tex l. 274). Not added to g_bar (D-104 rule 2): every quoted size comes from an M_BH–σ scaling of the lens's own velocity dispersion (D-036 #6). R28 sizes it at 2 per cent of M_Ein (l. 693), a larger share of M*(<R_E). Frozen v2 reading baryon_inventory.csv

Not addressed by R5 (SLACS), R13 (SLACS), R10 (S4TM), R9 (S4TM (method)), R20 (SL2S), R61 (SNL-1, SNL-2), R29 (J0403-0239), R21 (SL2S). R26 (SNELLS): addressed in dynamical model only: "Our fiducial mass model consists of three components: (1) the stellar mass traced by the the $r$-band luminosity, (2) a dark matter halo, and (3) a black hole on the \citet{McConnell13} $M_{\rm BH}$-$\sigma$ relation." (snells.tex l. 169); R26 lensing (M/L)_L and spectroscopic (M*/L)_MW, which v1 uses, do not subtract or add a BH. Listed in resolutions.md. R26's black hole is part of its dynamical model, not of a lensing g_bar (v2 reading, resolution 6). Frozen v2 reading baryon_inventory.csv

fields.name: method
fields.description: How g_obs and g_bar were obtained

fields.name: g_obs
fields.description: Observed acceleration in projection, G M_E / R_E^2 (D-064)

fields.name: g_obs_err_lo
fields.description: From the M_E error at fixed R_E. Empty on class A rows (standard §2a rule 7): there M_E is the mass inside the radius of mean convergence 1, so g_obs = π G Σ_cr does not depend on θ_E; the θ_E error is carried by g_bar through the term theta_e (or theta_e_ngc6505), and the row has the flag no_uncertainty

fields.name: g_obs_err_point_lo
fields.description: Point-scale g_obs error (§3): one value per lens, so equal to g_obs_err_lo; empty on class A rows

fields.name: g_bar
fields.description: Baryonic acceleration in projection, G (M*(<R_E) + M_gas(<R_E)) / R_E^2 (D-064)

fields.name: g_bar_err_lo
fields.description: From the stellar-mass error only, at fixed R_E; the θ_E error is in the term theta_e (§2a rule 7). On the two MaNGA lenses it also contains the shared Υ_ref, a dataset-scale term (upsilon_ref_manga)

fields.name: g_bar_err_point_lo
fields.description: Point-scale g_bar error (§3): equal to g_bar_err_lo, except on the two MaNGA lenses, where it is the L_Ein error alone (R32), propagated as v1 does, because g_bar_err_lo there also contains the shared Υ_ref, a dataset-scale term (upsilon_ref_manga; §2a rules 1 and 6)

fields.name: err_level
fields.description: Confidence level of g_obs_err_*, as the source states it (frozen reading err_levels.csv); empty where the column is empty

fields.name: err_level_status

fields.name: g_bar_err_level
fields.description: Confidence level of g_bar_err_*, as the source states it (frozen reading err_levels.csv); empty where the column is empty

fields.name: g_bar_err_level_status

fields.name: x_strong_lensing_theta_e_err_frac_hi
fields.description: Fractional θ_E error (upper side), as _lo. Size column of term theta_e (formula a6s_theta_e). Empty: no θ_E error of this kind is given for the row

fields.name: x_strong_lensing_theta_profile_form
fields.description: Light-profile form printed by the source (frozen reading profiles.csv), on rows whose v1 profile columns are empty; empty where none is printed or v1 already holds the profile

fields.name: x_strong_lensing_theta_profile_r_e_arcsec
fields.description: Effective radius of that profile, as printed; empty as for the form

fields.name: x_strong_lensing_theta_profile_n
fields.description: Sérsic index of that profile (4 = de Vaucouleurs); empty as for the form

fields.name: x_strong_lensing_dlngbar_dlntheta
fields.description: d ln g_bar / d ln θ_E at fixed redshifts and cosmology = −2 + d ln f(<R_E)/d ln R_E, from the printed profile (v1's columns or the theta_profile columns) by central difference (step 1e-4 in ln R_E) of the frozen aeg.lensing.sersic_projected_fraction. Exponent of the a6s_theta_e formula. Empty where no profile is printed: the θ_E effect on g_bar is not computed (D-104 rule 3)

fields.name: x_strong_lensing_g_bar_stars_ref
fields.description: G M*(<R_E)/R_E² at the source's population, computed as g_obs × mstar_re_msun / m_e_msun. Read by the v2 a6s_gas_in_RE formula, so that the gas term does not read g_obs

fields.name: x_strong_lensing_mass_ellipticity_frac
fields.description: Fractional increase of M_E from a small ellipticity, one-sided, upward (R29 l. 210); J0403−0239 only. Size column of term ellipticity_j0403 (in_error_columns = no). Empty: no size given

fields.name: x_strong_lensing_los_frac
fields.description: Line-of-sight effect on M_E as a fraction (R28 l. 320–322); SNL-0 only. Size column of term line_of_sight_snl0 (in_error_columns = no). Empty: no size given

fields.name: x_strong_lensing_neighbour_light_frac
fields.description: Neighbour light as a fraction (R26 l. 141); SNL-2 only. Size column of term neighbour_light_snl2 (in_error_columns = no). Empty: no size given

fields.name: x_strong_lensing_r_eff_err_frac
fields.description: Fractional R_e error stated by R20 for the imaging of the row's R_e (0.30 CFHT, 0.10 HST; frozen reading profiles.csv); SL2S rows only. Size column of term r_eff_sl2s (in_error_columns = no; effect not computed in v2). Empty: no size given
